{{Vanilla|Tuff}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Tuff''' is a gray volcanic stone found deep underground and in trial chambers. [[Matcha Flavoured]] sells it in bulk and lets most decorative tuff blocks be broken back down into plain tuff.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Tuff generates as in vanilla, and [[Trial Chambers|trial chambers]] are built from it.

=== Crafting and smelting ===
{{Recipes}}
The pack adds ways to undo tuff's decorative forms:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/tuff_from_blasting_polished_tuff.json}}</ref>
* A [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] turns polished tuff, tuff bricks, chiseled tuff and chiseled tuff bricks back into tuff ({{Value|Tuff|cook_time|station=Blast Furnace}} each).
* Two tuff slabs craft back into a block, and a [[stonecutter]] cuts tuff stairs back into tuff.

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 2 [[Bulk blocks|bulk tuff]] for 1 [[obol]] at the apprentice level; each unpacks into 64 tuff.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/tuff.json}}</ref>
